newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli shekel rises against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Israeli shekel rises against dollar.

text.p: The Israeli shekel strengthened slightly against the dollar in thin trading on Monday, dealers said.
"Trading was extremely quiet today and the shekel traded in a very narrow range. Activity was minimal and the shekel (representative rate) closed almost unchanged," said Guy Levi at Bank Leumi.

The representative rate for the dollar was fixed at 3.2430 shekels against 3.2450 on Friday. The basket, composed of the dollar, mark, pound sterling, French franc and yen, closed at 3.6519 shekels against 3.6500 on Friday.
On the crosses the shekel traded against the yen at 2.9170 shekels per 100 yen against 2.8976 on Friday and against the mark at 2.1553 shekels against 2.1482 on Friday.
In late afternoon the dollar was trading at 3.2450 shekels.
